title: Define the Outcome Before You Choose the Output
service: Outcomes: evidence-bounded outcome framing and lexical solution indicators
runtime: Python3.10+, standard library, pytest; no model or network

parts.lesson_anchor: The Six-Part Frame; Find Solution Leakage; Constraints can name technology when compatibility truly fixes it
planted_bugs: provided output alias ignored two calls below decision
blank boundary items accepted inside nonempty lists
any compatibility receipt incorrectly vouches for every technology
compatibility entries rescanned for every constraint
parts.overfix_guard: only desired outcome scanned; fixed technology constraints remain valid; each snapshot independent

parts.lesson_anchor: The Six-Part Frame; preserving evidence when shaping a frame
parts.storage: content-addressed JSON revision objects including parent digest
parts.exactness: Frame/Constraint types, multiline Unicode strings, lists and exact parent links survive reopen
traps: typed frame rehydration and independent loaded objects
unknown parent cannot leave orphan objects

parts.lesson_anchor: Find Solution Leakage examples: product form, model/framework/architecture, weekly summary/cadence
parts.algorithm: left-to-right longest finite normalized-token phrase with original character spans and id ties
traps: same-start longer phrase before shorter prefix
whole tokens and finite supplied normalization
original-character offsets instead of normalized or byte offsets

parts.lesson_anchor: Exercises rewriting feature requests, adding constraints and non-goals during framing
parts.wire_format: private unified-diff-style blocks @@ edit N @@ then -/+ issue lines
traps: quiet edits consume ordinal; no initial baseline block
complete current edit block before future pull
private deep copy and supported field names

parts.lesson_anchor: Constraints Protect the Outcome; Non-Goals Create a Boundary; goal refinement
traps: nearest user inherits without sibling leakage
ancestor excluded ids persist at any depth
preorder, independent tuples and missing-user errors

deviations: Finite aliases, compatibility receipts, phrase categories and normalization are exercise data, not claims of general natural-language understanding. Technology receipts are bound by exact technology name.
Part1 indexes compatibility evidence rather than repeating Part3 phrase matching as its timing layer. Only missing alias/list/receipt binding and linear receipt lookup are planted.

Tokenizer and complete issue-set _delta are supplied correct. Part4 candidate work is edit continuation/ordinal/private state and current-block emission, not repeating chapter38/40/44 content-deduplication.
Content-addressed revisions model framing history. Explicit set-valued constraints and stable non-goal ids make outcome decomposition deterministic; this does not infer free-text implication.
Part3 uses finite phrase matching with supplied character offsets instead of requiring a trie, arbitrary synonym inference or a full morphology engine in60minutes.
